name: @milady/plugin-zerc20
description: zERC20 privacy-preserving token transfers plugin for Milady — wrap, unwrap, private send, and cross-chain teleport using zero-knowledge proofs (EIP-7503)

ZERC20_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Hex private key for the wallet used for zERC20 wrapping, unwrapping, and receiving. Falls back to the agent's default EVM key if not set.

ZERC20_SEED_HEX.description: Stealth seed for deriving burn addresses and scanning incoming private transfers. If omitted, derived from the wallet private key.

ZERC20_INDEXER_URL.description: URL of the zERC20 indexer service for querying transfer events and merkle proofs.

ZERC20_DECIDER_URL.description: URL of the zERC20 decider prover service for generating Nova IVC proofs.
